rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one dominant stepped mass, not as colliding fragments. The silhouette is legible and capacity-bearing, with a clear hierarchy between a broader lower body and reduced upper tiers. The parcel is contained without simply filling the box, and the mass responds decently to the site boundary. The main weakness is that the public void / ground-level openness is only moderately expressed; the verified access edge is acknowledged but not strongly activated by a court or entry seam. Program-wise, the mass can plausibly support neighborhood living / mixed-use as a compact street building, though it is more object-like than truly threshold-rich. The overall section logic is acceptable for the brief, but the ground/public edge could be stronger.
